notes.title: Patch Notes 1.10
notes.notes: [p]We have released patch 1.10 for [i]RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army[/i]. Additionally, accompanying this update, we would like to share a message from the game's Producer/Director, Yamai Kazuyuki.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558630/fc5bee167906c384a15da7ea4743ff0b43d1f218.png"][/img][/p][p]Please see the details of the fixes included:[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]1) QOL Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]MAG can now be collected through gun attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a “Hold” input option for Weak Sword Attacks and Strong Sword Attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Button/key assigned to safeguarding demon allies is now remappable.[/p][/*][*][p]Demon allies will no longer waste MAG by using skills unnecessarily once battle ends.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added “Retry battle on another difficulty” option when Raidou is defeated.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sell demonic materials at Konnou-ya.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now travel directly to Konnou-ya through Dragon Founts.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ON/OFF toggles for the next objective UI, destination icons, and applicable investigation skills so players can enjoy the atmosphere of the original game.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced carry-over elements for New Game+.[/p][list][*][p][u]Totality[/u][/p][p]Raidou's level, stats, money, Devil Chart, and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over. Summoner Skills, swords forged through Sword Alchemy, and items will also be carried over, with some exceptions.[/p][/*][*][p][u]Luxuries[/u][/p][p]Raidou's money, Devil Chart, and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over. Summoner Skills, swords forged through Sword Alchemy, and items will also be carried over, with some exceptions.[/p][/*][*][p][u]Basics[/u][/p][p]Raidou's Devil Chart and accumulated Loyalty will be carried over.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Balance adjustments for the following battles:[/p][list][*][p]Episode 1: Gashadokuro[/p][/*][*][p]Episode 1: Ichimokuren[/p][/*][*][p]Episode 8: Mishaguji[/p][/*][*][p]Final Episode battles[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Devil Chart now displays demon registration completion rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ON/OFF toggle for shortening demon fusion animations.[/p][/*][*][p]After demon fusion, the game will no longer return to the fusion top menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Shortened animation when reforging a sword that has already been crafted in Sword Alchemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced downtime after summoning a demon ally in the field.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to skip the greeting animation during demon reports.[/p][/*][*][p]Even when Raidou’s title is manually selected, the rank-up animation will play when a new title is unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]When completing a case file, the name of the completed quest will now be shown in the completion animation (to avoid confusion about which quest was cleared).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the frequency of Gouto saying “Use your gun.”[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]2) Other[/b][/p][p]Various bug fixes.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you for your continued support of [i]RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army[/i]![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.03
notes.notes: [p]We have released patch 1.03 for RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army, please see the details of the fixes included:[/p][list][*][p]The freezing issue at the Soda Joint in the final chapter has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Issue where progression became impossible on the loading screen, under certain language settings, following the cutscene after entering a name has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support of RAIDOU Remastered: The Mystery of the Soulless Army![/p]
